about_the_game:
Tactical Warfare from a New Perspective

Hell Of War is a large-scale tactical game that combines first-person shooting with real-time battlefield strategy.

You start as a combat drone operator — scouting enemy positions, coordinating allied forces, calling in various types of artillery strikes, deploying minefields, and bringing infantry, armored vehicles, and different combat drones into battle.
But at any moment, you can personally enter the fight by taking direct control of an infantry soldier, a tank, or an FPV drone.

Command the Battle

Scout the battlefield with drones, launch FPV strikes and aerial drops, and deploy assault groups at key locations.

Call in different types of artillery, lay minefields, deploy various vehicles and combat drones, and coordinate the attack.

Command infantry squads through field commanders: issue real-time orders to move, assault, defend, or cover.

Fight on the Frontline

IAt any moment, you can take control of any allied unit: lead an infantry assault, command a tank, or pilot a drone in the heart of battle.

From the precision of each shot to critical strategic decisions — everything is in your hands.

A Dynamic Battlefield

The battlefield constantly reacts to your decisions: artillery strikes, minefields, air support, breakthroughs, assaults, and strategic captures — everything demands planning and quick reactions.
Tactical flexibility decides the outcome.

Key Features

  • Full control of a combat drone: reconnaissance, various types of artillery strikes and minefields, navigation, and battlefield coordination

  • Deploy infantry, vehicles, and combat drones at pre-planned assault points

  • Instantly switch control between units — from infantry commanders to tank operators and FPV drone pilots

  • Real-time infantry command: attack, defend, move, and cover maneuvers

  • Use air support, FPV drones, and artillery strikes to break enemy lines

  • Realistic first-person combat with a strong focus on tactical engagements

  • Deep tactical gameplay: maneuvering, using cover, flanking, seizing high ground, and coordinating unit movements

  • A living, reactive battlefield where every decision has consequences

Your Battlefield. Your Strategy. Your War.

Hell Of War isn’t just about fighting.

It’s a battlefield where you are the commander, the assault force, and the scout — all at once.

Every decision shapes the outcome of the battle.

  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Hell Of War offers a fresh take on modern battlefield tactics. Take command from above as a drone operator: call in artillery strikes, perform artillery mining, launch drones, control vehicles, and lead infantry assaults as a squad commander. A tactical shooter with deep real-time strategy.
